description: Generate 2-3 sentence professional summary options from resume text. Produces multiple variants -- confident, technical, and leadership-focused -- tailored to the detected career level (entry/mid/senior/executive). Optionally target a specific role for more focused output.

resume_text.description: The full text content of the resume to generate a summary from

target_role.description: The target job title or role to tailor the summary toward (e.g., 'Engineering Manager')

name: generate_summary
